beats.label: What's new
beats.text: Four medical groups mapped women's heart risk to **life** **stages.**
beats.note: AHA, AAP, ACOG & SMFM, Circulation, Oct 26, 2026

beats.label: Clue 1: your cycle
beats.text: **Heavy** or **irregular** periods may be an **early** risk marker.

beats.label: Clue 2: pregnancy
beats.text: Pregnancy works like a heart **stress** **test.** Preeclampsia and gestational diabetes **count.**

beats.label: Why it matters
beats.text: Heart disease kills **400,000+** U.S. women a year. Only **41%** call it their top threat.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: This is **guidance,** not a new study. A heavy period **doesn't** mean heart disease.
Follow for women's health news, **minus** the **panic.**
